facts.fact: The CEDSIF state information-systems centre page specifies e-SGA, a single integrated municipal management system of 22 modules including municipal revenue management, markets and street trading, and commercial rents, with ANAMM named as client; the page gives no date, so the published date 2026-08-08 is used.

systems.country_label: Sistema Informatico para a Gestao Autarquica

note: A specification stated as what the system 'should' be; no rollout, count of municipalities, funding or plan stated.
